rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: Under the heading printed 'Rocket Firp on Plane Carrying BJP President', Shri Vishwasrao Ramrao Patil's question asks whether militants opened rocket fire on 'the plane carrying Dr. Murli Manohar Joshi, President, BJP' as it took off from Srinagar for Jammu on 26 January; the Minister of State, Shri M. M. Jacob, answers that the Government of Jammu and Kashmir had no confirmed report that 'the aeroplane carrying the President of Bharatiya Janata Party' was attacked.
